hazards.label: DD-2 (10 % in 50 years, the design earthquake): controlled damage (KH)

sources.targetDisplacement.hazards: TBDY 2018 3.4, Tablo 3.4a-b: the performance levels limited damage (SH), controlled damage (KH) and collapse prevention (GO) under DD-3, DD-2 and DD-1, checked with the base pack's ASCE 41-17 hinge levels IO, LS and CP (SAEngine practice: TBDY 5.8 gives its own strain limits, not built). The DD-1 spectrum scale 1.5 is SAEngine practice and must be replaced by the site's SDS(DD-1)/SDS(DD-2) (a project's Code Value); a DD-3 limited damage (IO) level can be added the same way with the site's DD-3 ratio.
sources.targetDisplacement.coefficients.siteFact: ASCE 41-17 Table 7-3 a of the nearest ASCE site class (ZA, ZB as A/B 130; ZC as C 90; ZD, ZE, ZF 60): SAEngine practice
